dct_title_s: Building Damage Assesment in Sambene, Nanguasse & Muinde villages, Mecufi Posto, Mecufi District as of 17 December 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20241212MOZ, GDACS ID: 1001131** This map illustrates affected structures in Mecufi Posto, Mecufi District, Cabo Delgado Province as observed from a Pleiades satellite image acquired on 17 December 2024 at 07:51 Local Time. Within the analysed area, UNOSAT identified 2,433 destroyed structures and 1,684 damaged structures amongst a total of 4,118 structures observed. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
